text:
mira: Heads up — product wants to run a week-long spring promotion in late May. We expect a traffic spike to the hosted API. Rough forecast: +40% qps for 7 days. Need options for covering ~1.1k–1.5k extra GPU-hours/day. Thoughts on buy vs short lease vs spot + fallback? :thinking:

alex: quick math from perf sims — baseline currently ~2.8k GPU-hours/day. +40% => ~3.9k–4.0k GPU-hours/day. So surge delta ~1.1k–1.2k GPU-hours/day. I'll attach a sim in a sec.

ben: cost signals — 1) 3-month lease (on-demand contract) estimated $2.10/GPU-hour; 2) spot/preemptible ~ $0.65/GPU-hour (but churn risk); 3) amortized buy (capex) ~ $0.43/GPU-hour over 3 years assuming 60% utilization. For a 7-day event, lease looks cheapest non-risky option.

sara: procurement note — new hardware buy lead time is 8–12 weeks for order -> rack -> online. Not realistic for late-May event unless we expedite and accept premium.

mira: ops constraints — APAC region has limited spare capacity and we have a networking egress cap on the singapore region (2.5Gbps burst). If we place surge in APAC we might hit egress throttles for embeddings-heavy workloads. Consider US-west or eu for overflow.

ops-bot: [automated report] hosted-api cluster utilization (past 7d): avg 62%, p95 latency 120ms, avg batching 18 tokens/request. Current free reserved pool: 420 GPU-hours/day.

alex: proposal A: short term lease for ~1.2k GPU-hours/day in us-west for 7 days (spot for 20% buffer). Estimated blended cost ~ $1.9k/day. Proposal B: spot + aggressive autoscaler + canary fallback to smaller model variants if preemptions spike.

ben: rough numbers — if we go all-lease: (1.2k * 24?) wait that's GPU-hours/day already. So 1.2k * $2.10 = $2,520/day. For 7 days = $17,640. Spot option expected cost ~ $5,460 but risk of 20–30% service degradation during preemptions unless we route to fallback models.

mira: fallback plan idea — enable model-fallback policy (gpt-ish-medium -> gpt-ish-small) for non-critical routes and enable per-route latency SLO relaxation to 200ms for the promotion window. Product ok? @jay?

jay: product: we can relax SLOs for marketing routes only. Need list of route IDs and expected error budget consumption. Also want telemetry on quality regression for the promotion cohort.

alex: here's a tiny calc block I ran locally: ```python
surge_delta = 1200
lease_rate = 2.10
days = 7
cost = surge_delta * lease_rate * days
print(cost)  # 17640
```

ben: also consider hybrid: reserve short lease for 800 GPU-hrs/day + spot for the remaining 400. Gives cost ~ (800*$2.1 + 400*$0.65)*7 = ~(1680+260)*7 = $13,090. Lower risk than full spot.

sara: finance approval path — for one-off leases under $25k we can fast-track, above that needs manager signoff. So both pure-lease and hybrid fall under fast-track which is good.

mira: network placement decision: route promotion traffic to us-west primary, eu fallback. Avoid APAC unless we can confirm egress bump. ops-bot — can you schedule a quick capacity warm-up 48h prior?

ops-bot: scheduled: capacity-warmup job created for 2026-05-20 03:00 UTC. Warmup will pre-populate KV caches and spin reserved nodes.

ben: action items: 1) alex to open lease quote (region + exact GPU type), 2) ops to configure hybrid autoscaler + fallback rules, 3) sara to file fast-track finance request, 4) jay to list route IDs for SLO relaxation.

mira: thanks — if we can get quotes today we can lock the lease and avoid last-minute price spikes. I'll coordinate with product and marketing. :thumbsup:
